context_for_next_testing_agent: The new psychic booking flow is fully implemented and working. Participant detail pages now use <Link to='/zapis-na-priem?psychic=slug'> instead of modal popups. BookingPage correctly reads ?psychic= query param, fetches participant data, and displays personalized title with Russian dative case declension. ApplicationForm sends psychic_slug and psychic_name in POST request. Admin panel ApplicationsAdmin.js shows Экстрасенс column in table and detail dialog. All 8 participants work: elena-golunova, angelina-izosimova, viktoriya-raidos, nadezhda-shevchenko, aleksandr-sheps, oleg-sheps, zuliya-radzhabova, vlad-cherevatyy.
